lines.s2a: A course says everything three times. On the board. In the textbook. On a slide.
lines.s2b: Ask a chatbot, and it answers from somewhere else.
lines.s3b: A study companion that can only say what your course says, and shows you exactly where.
lines.s4a: Ask it anything about your course.
lines.s4b: Every sentence of the answer carries a number.
lines.s4c: One opens the textbook, at the page, with the passage outlined.
lines.s4d: Another opens the lecture, at the second it was said.
lines.s5a: Getting there takes more than reading text. This textbook's file has no equations in its text. They are drawings.
lines.s5b: So Pramana reads every page, every slide, and the board itself, with a vision model.
lines.s5c: Nine hundred and sixty-one citable pieces of one course. Almost two thirds of them unreadable without vision.
lines.s6a: Ask what the course does not cover, and it tells you so.
lines.s6b: Even when the question sounds like physics.
lines.s6c: Ask in Hinglish, and it answers in Hinglish, from the same page.
lines.s7a: Then it turns the course into questions, each one checked by a second model, and by arithmetic.
lines.s7b: A wrong answer is read, not just marked: the misconception, and the page.
lines.s7c: Behind it, a model of what you know: nineteen concepts, linked by what depends on what.
lines.s7e: And your week is planned around what you are about to forget.
lines.s7f: And when a concept needs teaching, it cuts you a lesson: a short film on your weakest concept, made only from your own course.
lines.s8b: Thirty-nine questions whose source we know. The right page, slide, or second is in the top three, eighty-seven percent of the time.
lines.s8r: RAGAS scores the answers themselves: faithfulness, answer relevancy, and context precision.
lines.s8c: Take vision away, and a quarter of what the answers need is gone.
lines.s8g: Outside the course, it declined fourteen questions of fourteen. And ninety-eight percent of its cited sentences are fully supported.
lines.s8d: With simulated students, adaptive practice beats random questions, and beats plain syllabus order for novices. Fast learners still do better with the syllabus. That is in the report too.
lines.s8e: Every number in this film is in the repository, with the command that reproduces it.
